units.source_text: 这封信系在一个菖蒲根上，这根非常长，教人难于忘记。

en.t: This letter was tied to the root of an iris, and the root was so long that it was hard to forget.

units.source_text: 源氏对玉鬘说：“今天这封信你应该答复。”

en.t: Genji said to Tamakazura, "You should answer this letter today."
After saying this, he went out.

units.source_text: 众侍女也都劝她写回信。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting also urged her to write a reply.

units.source_text: 玉鬘自己大概亦有此意，便答诗云：

en.t: Tamakazura herself probably felt the same way, and so she answered with this poem:
